insights.finding: Mid-Year Sale is the strongest promo and Spring Launch the weakest.
insights.evidence: Median Net Profit 20,166 (6 weeks) vs 4,290 (7 weeks); weakest runs at 11.2% median discount.
insights.action: Repeat Mid-Year Sale; reprice or drop Spring Launch.

insights.finding: Jul is the strongest month and Jan the weakest by net margin.
insights.evidence: Average Net Margin 9.7% in Jul vs 1.8% in Jan; loss-week rate 0% vs 28%.
insights.action: Schedule big promos in or near Jul; hold spend steady in Jan.

insights.finding: LTV to CAC is improving at 9.7 (last 13 weeks).
insights.evidence: 9.74 vs 8.01 in the prior 13 weeks (+21.6%); 0 weeks below the 3.0 floor of 208.
insights.action: Acquisition pays back; keep funding it while watching CAC.

insights.finding: Search spend is most associated with Net Profit; Display the least.
insights.evidence: Permutation importance share: Search 31%, Display 4%. Driver model holdout R2 0.01: weak (holdout R2 low), so treat as a hint to test.
insights.action: Test a small budget move toward Search and watch weekly profit before scaling.

insights.finding: Email returns the most revenue per extra unit of spend recently; Search the least.
insights.evidence: Marginal return 22.49 (Email, 9% of spend) vs 0.00 (Search, 41% of spend). Associated with, not proof of, cause.
insights.action: Rule check: Shift 10% of budget here (test) for Email; hold current budget for Search.

insights.finding: Next 13 weeks Net Revenue is forecast up 3.0% vs the last 13 weeks.
insights.evidence: Forecast 2,349,058 vs 2,279,739 actual; method moving_avg_4w; Net Profit forecast 302,308 (method GradientBoostingRegressor). Accuracy claim: revenue False, profit True.
insights.action: Plan the quarter on the forecast band, not a single number.

insights.finding: 47% of recent orders come from new customers; repeat rate is 53.5%.
insights.evidence: Repeat customer rate 53.5% vs 53.9% in the prior 13 weeks; new-customer share of orders 46.5%.
insights.action: Retention is carrying a good part of orders; protect it.

insights.finding: 11 unusual weeks were flagged (5% of history).
insights.evidence: W119: marketing % of revenue is 3.1 std dev above normal (21.61 vs typical 14.83); W169: CTR % is 2.7 std dev above normal (2.59 vs typical 2.12)
insights.action: Review the flagged weeks for tracking errors, stock-outs or one-off events before using them in plans.

insights.evidence: 25 loss weeks of 208. Early-warning model (LogisticRegression): recall 92%, precision 12% (out-of-fold).
insights.action: Review planned promo weeks flagged at risk before launch; confirm discount depth against the limit.

insights.finding: Cash covers 26.8 weeks of payroll, opex and marketing (above the 8-week floor).
insights.evidence: Cash balance 1,574,870; lowest runway in history 4.1 weeks; weeks under the floor: 64.
insights.action: Cash is safe; keep the floor as a guardrail for any spend increase.

insights.finding: Return rate is 4.6% of gross revenue recently (limit 5.1%).
insights.evidence: 52 of 208 weeks above the limit; returns cost 112,769 over the last 13 weeks.
insights.action: Returns are in the normal range; keep tracking after promos.

insights.evidence: AR outstanding 73,705; DSO above the limit in 31 of 208 weeks.
insights.action: Collections are within the normal range; keep monitoring.

insights.finding: Promo weeks earn more than normal weeks by 2,098 in median Net Profit.
insights.evidence: Median Net Profit 10,359 in 39 promo weeks vs 8,261 in 169 normal weeks; loss-week rate 5% vs 14%.
insights.action: Promos are profitable overall; protect depth limits and repeat the best events.
